title: Stopping music in 1928: low pay, marriage, odd jobs
summary: Eddie says he stopped around 1928 when the pay fell to a dollar, he got a job and married. The sibling clarifies he later played only occasional odd jobs, never a regular band.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music
